sections.text_helper: Section 15.2 "SysTick calibration value register" in chapter 15 (Nested vectored interrupt controller (NVIC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 440.
sections.section_content:
The Cortex-M33 embeds one SysTick timer. The SysTick timer calibration value (STCALIB)
is 0x3E8. It gives a reference time base of 1ms based on a SysTick clock frequency of
1MHz. To match the 1ms time base for an application running at a given frequency, the
SysTick reload value must be programmed as follows in the SYST_RVR register:
• When the SysTick clock source is CPU clock HCLK
the reload value = (HCLK x STCALIB)-1
• When the SysTick clock source is an external clock (HCLK/8)
the reload value = ((HCLK/8) x STCALIB)-1
The HCLK refers to the AHB frequency value in MHz.
Example: The SysTick clock source is a CPU clock HCLK of 100MHz, to match a time base
of 1ms:
SysTick reload value = (100 x STCALIB)-1 = 0x1869F
